apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: monitoring
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: monitoring
    app.kubernetes.io/name: prometheus-node-exporter
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: prometheus-node-exporter
  namespace: monitoring
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: node-exporter
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: monitoring
automountServiceAccountToken: false

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: prometheus-node-exporter
  namespace: monitoring
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: node-exporter
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: monitoring
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: node-exporter
      app.kubernetes.io/part-of: monitoring
  updateStrategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 10%
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: node-exporter
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: monitoring
      annotations:
        prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
        prometheus.io/port: "9100"
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: prometheus-node-exporter
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      hostNetwork: false
      hostPID: false
      nodeSelector:
        kubernetes.io/os: linux
      tolerations:
        - key: "node-role.kubernetes.io/master"
          operator: "Exists"
          effect: "NoSchedule"
        - key: "node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane"
          operator: "Exists"
          effect: "NoSchedule"
        - key: "node.kubernetes.io/not-ready"
          operator: "Exists"
          effect: "NoExecute"
          tolerationSeconds: 120
        - key: "node.kubernetes.io/unreachable"
          operator: "Exists"
          effect: "NoExecute"
          tolerationSeconds: 120
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 65534
        runAsGroup: 65534
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: node-exporter
          image: quay.io/prometheus/node-exporter:v1.8.1
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          args:
            - '--path.rootfs=/host/root'
            - '--path.procfs=/host/proc'
            - '--path.sysfs=/host/sys'
            - '--collector.filesystem.ignored-mount-points=^/(dev|proc|sys|run|var/lib/docker/.+|var/lib/containerd/.+|var/lib/kubelet/pods/.+|var/lib/rkt|var/lib/containers/storage/.+|var/lib/crio/.+|var/lib/openebs/.+|var/lib/longhorn/.+|var/lib/rancher/.+|snap/.+|var/lib/snapd/.+|var/lib/lxd/.+|var/lib/flatpak/.+)($|/)'
            - '--collector.filesystem.ignored-fs-types=^(sysfs|proc|rootfs|rpc_pipefs|securityfs|devtmpfs|configfs|cgroup.*|pstore|efivarfs|bpf|autofs|mqueue|hugetlbfs|fusectl|tracefs|debugfs|nsfs|overlay|squashfs)$'
          ports:
            - name: metrics
              containerPort: 9100
              protocol: TCP
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: metrics
              scheme: HTTP
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 6
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: metrics
              scheme: HTTP
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 20
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 256Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
          volumeMounts:
            - name: proc
              mountPath: /host/proc
              readOnly: true
            - name: sys
              mountPath: /host/sys
              readOnly: true
            - name: root
              mountPath: /host/root
              readOnly: true
      volumes:
        - name: proc
          hostPath:
            path: /proc
            type: Directory
        - name: sys
          hostPath:
            path: /sys
            type: Directory
        - name: root
          hostPath:
            path: /
            type: Directory
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: prometheus-node-exporter
  namespace: monitoring
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: node-exporter
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: monitoring
  annotations:
    prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
    prometheus.io/port: "9100"
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: node-exporter
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: monitoring
  ports:
    - name: metrics
      port: 9100
      protocol: TCP
      targetPort: metrics
